question: Review this code for defects. List EVERY defect you find, one per line, and briefly say why each is a problem. Look beyond obvious issues — consider subtle logic errors, concurrency, numeric edge cases, and specification mismatches.
note: Harder set: subtle/ambiguous defects where frontier models are expected to DIVERGE (decorrelated errors). Contrast with tasks.json (well-known defect classes, correlated errors).

tasks.title: Running median (subtle numeric + logic)

defects.description: Running sum accumulates floating-point drift over long inputs
window=0 → divide by zero / wrong indexing, unguarded

defects.pattern: window (>|greater|larger|exceed).*(length|len|size|array)|window bigger than|returns empty|no output when window
defects.description: window > length silently returns [] with no signal

tasks.title: Exponential backoff (concurrency + correctness)

defects.description: After all retries fail, returns undefined and swallows the last error

defects.pattern: jitter|thundering herd|synchroniz(e|ed) retr|all clients retry|random(ness|ized)? delay
defects.description: No jitter → thundering-herd / synchronized retries
delay doubles unbounded — no max ceiling
Retries non-retriable errors (e.g. 400) the same as transient

tasks.title: LRU cache (spec mismatch + subtle bug)

defects.description: get() doesn't refresh recency → not actually LRU (only insertion-order eviction)
Re-setting an existing key can evict another before overwriting (size check wrong for updates)
>= evicts when size equals max before insert → holds max-1 items

tasks.title: Date-range overlap (boundary + tz)

defects.description: Strict < treats touching intervals (aEnd == bStart) as overlap or not — boundary semantics unspecified/likely wrong for bookings
No validation that start < end; reversed range breaks the check
Comparison assumes comparable, same-tz values; mixed Date/string/tz silently misbehaves

tasks.title: Quantity parser (coercion traps)

defects.description: parseInt without radix mis-parses some strings (leading-zero/octal legacy edge)

defects.pattern: NaN|not a number|non[- ]?numeric|invalid qty|total becomes NaN|Number.isNaN|isNaN|contaminat
defects.description: Non-numeric qty → NaN silently poisons the whole total
Floating-point arithmetic on money accumulates rounding errors
parseInt truncates fractional quantities silently

tasks.title: One-time event (listener leak + ordering)

defects.description: emit can be called twice; handlers run again — not really once-semantics
A handler added after fire is both called immediately AND left in handlers for a future emit → double-invocation
handlers array is never cleared → listener/memory leak after fire
A throwing handler halts the rest (forEach has no isolation)
